scope: Evaluation-role routing of existing evidence plus bounded interpretation of saved outputs; not a truth packet, classifier, runtime configuration or replacement scoring engine.

authorization.adopted_direction: Organize by scene/claim and principle, failure-response, workflow roles; assess partial failures by impact; suspend the compressor-versus-public A/B choice.
authorization.not_selected: No new numerical error budget, field pass, domain exclusion or algorithm.
